capacity.summary: minimum and 5th percentile cohort proxy across active cohorts, computed independently for development and for holdout if opened

causal_clock.eligible_funding_row: calc_time is strictly less than h, preserving source milliseconds
causal_clock.example: a funding row at 08:00:00.000Z or 08:00:00.001Z is first signal-eligible at 09:00:00.000Z

dispersion_transition.baseline: B_t = median of the 28 immediately preceding distinct decision-epoch dispersion observations, excluding D_t
dispersion_transition.compression: for each of the prior C distinct decision epochs s, D_s <= B_s
dispersion_transition.dispersion: D_t = median absolute deviation from the cross-sectional median of the 30 latest eligible normalized rates
dispersion_transition.transition: the prior distinct-epoch dispersion is <= B_t, B_t > 0, and D_t / B_t >= X

distinct_from_s1c_through_s1u.portfolio: three matched USD-M long-short innovation pairs from a June-2025 liquidity-screened 30-symbol cohort
distinct_from_s1c_through_s1u.signal: cross-sectional median-absolute-deviation compression followed by dispersion expansion, then same-sign interval-stable funding innovation

execution.entry: mark-price kline OPEN exactly at decision epoch h
execution.exit: mark-price kline OPEN exactly at h plus H hours
execution.nonoverlap: within each trial, decision epochs strictly before or equal to an existing cohort exit are skipped; same-open exit and re-entry is forbidden
execution.price_return: signed linear-contract quantity times exit open minus entry open

funding_cashflow.formula: cashflow = -side_sign * absolute_contract_quantity * hourly_mark_open_proxy * last_funding_rate, where side_sign is +1 long and -1 short
funding_cashflow.funding_mark_proxy: markPriceKlines/1h OPEN at floor(calc_time to its UTC hour)
funding_cashflow.included_settlements: funding rows with calc_time strictly greater than entry time and strictly less than exit time
funding_cashflow.role: PnL only and never signal after entry

funding_rate_semantics.dispersion_member_rule: all selected members having a valid latest eligible row at the decision epoch
funding_rate_semantics.freshness_at_each_decision: for every selected member, h - latest.calc_time must be <= 1.5 * latest.funding_interval_hours * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds; a violation is INVALID_EVIDENCE_UNMEASURED
funding_rate_semantics.latest_snapshot_value: latest eligible normalized rate per selected member
funding_rate_semantics.missing_prior_row_during_valid_warmup: decision epoch is cash for every trial

innovation.formula: delta_i_t = latest normalized rate at t minus that symbol's immediately prior causally known normalized settled rate
innovation.negative_pool_order: delta ascending, then symbol ASCII ascending
innovation.pair_history_requirement: both observations have the same funding_interval_hours
innovation.positive_pool_order: delta descending, then symbol ASCII ascending
innovation.sign_requirement: both rates are nonzero and have the same sign

matching.candidate_sets: fixed selected top-three positive and bottom-three negative innovation symbols
matching.canonical_pair_order: sort each matching by long_symbol then short_symbol
matching.objective: minimize the sum across pairs of absolute differences between long and short prior normalized rates
matching.tie_break: lexicographically smallest canonical tuple of (long_symbol, short_symbol)

funding_validation.maximum_gap_rule: adjacent calc_time gap in milliseconds must be <= 1.5 * max(left_interval_hours, right_interval_hours) * 3600000 + 1000

bootstrap.bonferroni_lcb: for each trial and scenario, form each replicate's centered-resampled whole-partition total by summing its n sampled centered daily nets and sort the B totals ascending; q is the 1-based ceil((1 - alpha/12) * B) order statistic; the reported net-USD-per-fixed-1000 LCB is the observed whole-partition total minus q, algebraically n times the corresponding observed-daily-mean-minus-centered-resampled-mean form
bootstrap.bootstrap_centered_statistic: for one-sided p-values and White's Reality Check, sqrt(n) * mean of the resampled centered daily series; the Bonferroni LCB instead uses the algebraically equivalent whole-partition-total scale specified in bonferroni_lcb
bootstrap.centered_resample: subtract each trial-scenario daily-series mean before applying the sampled circular-block day indices
bootstrap.one_sided_centered_p: (1 + count of bootstrap centered statistics >= observed sqrt(n) * mean) / (B + 1); ties use >=
bootstrap.paired_indices: each replicate uses the same sampled partition-day indices for every trial and every cost scenario

counters.active_cohorts: count full six-leg cohorts whose entry UTC timestamp is inside the scored partition
counters.active_weeks: count unique UTC ISO (week-year, week-number) pairs of full-cohort entry timestamps
counters.distinct_symbols: cardinality of the union of all six legs across active full cohorts
counters.valid_causal_epochs: count unique development UTC hours with at least one changed latest funding row and a complete fresh 30-member latest-row snapshot; a dispersion transition or trade event is not required

statistics.daily_calendar: the fixed complete UTC calendar days of the scored partition
statistics.daily_realization: assign each complete cohort's entire final realized scenario net, including price PnL, funding cashflow, fees, and adverse-execution costs, to its UTC exit day; every other fixed partition calendar day is exactly zero
statistics.drawdown: severe-scenario maximum peak-to-trough loss on complete UTC-hour marked equity divided by fixed 1000 USD gross; equity includes open-cohort mark PnL, realized costs and funding, and reserved severe exit costs

multiplicity.familywise_lower_bound: Bonferroni one-sided centered circular-bootstrap whole-partition-total LCB in net USD per fixed 1000 USD gross at alpha/12, separately for base and stress
multiplicity.holm: raw trial p is max(base one-sided centered p, stress one-sided centered p); order by raw p then trial_id; reject step-down while p_(i) <= alpha/(12-i+1), stopping at first failure; adjusted p_(i) = min(1, max over k<=i of (12-k+1)*p_(k)) and is mapped back to trial_id
multiplicity.white_reality_check: computed separately for base and stress; T_obs=max_j sqrt(n)*mean(y_j); center every trial by its own mean; each replicate applies the same sampled day indices to all centered trials and computes T_b=max_j sqrt(n)*mean(resampled centered y_j); p=(1+count T_b>=T_obs)/(B+1), ties use >=

pbo.cohort_inclusion: PBO-only: include a cohort only when its closed interval [entry, exit] is wholly within one 20-day score segment; otherwise its PBO contribution is zero
pbo.is_winner: maximum mean stress daily net across the six selected 20-day score segments; tie by trial_id ascending
pbo.method: CSCV on the fixed first 264 development UTC days beginning at development_start
pbo.oos_rank: rank the IS winner by mean stress daily net across the complementary six score segments; rank 1 is best and equal scores receive their worst rank, equal to count of trial scores >= the winner score
pbo.pbo: number of lambda <= 0 losses divided by 924, without plus-one adjustment

robustness.per_leg_stress_contribution: signed quantity * (exit mark open - entry mark open) + that leg's funding cashflow - that leg's actual entry and exit stress fee-plus-adverse costs
robustness.remove_best_month: aggregate complete-cohort stress net by UTC YYYY-MM of entry; choose the maximum even when every month is negative, breaking ties by earliest YYYY-MM; remove every cohort entered in that month and recompute stress net on the unchanged complete calendar
robustness.remove_best_symbol: aggregate per-leg stress contribution by symbol; choose the maximum even when every symbol is nonpositive, breaking ties by symbol ASCII ascending; remove every complete cohort containing that symbol and recompute stress net on the unchanged complete calendar

statistics.selection_metric: maximize the minimum of base and stress Bonferroni one-sided lower confidence bounds
selection_tie_breaks: lower severe complete-hour marked-equity maximum drawdown
statistics.unit: net USD per fixed 1000 USD gross
